sources.title: Vite 6.0 release announcement · Node.js support
sources.excerpt: Vite 6 supports Node.js 18, 20, and 22+, similar to Vite 5.
sources.rule: Vite 6 supports Node.js 18.x, 20.x, and 22.0.0 or later.

sources.title: Vite 7.0 release announcement · Node.js support
sources.rule: Vite 7 supports Node.js 20.x from 20.19.0, and Node.js 22.12.0 or later.

sources.title: Vite 6 build options · build.target
sources.excerpt: The default value is a Vite special value, 'modules'
sources.rule: The default build.target in Vite 6 is 'modules'.

sources.title: Vite 7 build options · build.target
sources.excerpt: The default value is a Vite special value, 'baseline-widely-available'
sources.rule: The default build.target in Vite 7 is 'baseline-widely-available'.
